time_convention: t = frame / fps, frame 0 at t = 0; frame for time t = round(t * fps)

image.rendered_area: x 420-1499, y 0-1079 (1080x1080 square); x < 420 and x > 1499 are black pillarbox bars

units: pixels (full-resolution image coordinates, x right, y down) and seconds

camera.motion: static (phase correlation of background vs frame 0: |shift| < 0.03 px at frames 15, 45, 96)
camera.view: top-down (nadir): the camera looks straight down at a flat gallery floor
camera.evidence: floor-tile grout lines are evenly spaced over the whole image (horizontal lines every 131 px at y = 48,179,310,441,572,703,834,966 at both x~475 and x~1445; vertical lines every 140 px at x = 539,679,820,960,1100,1240,1379 at both y~290 and y~750) -> floor plane parallel to the image plane, no horizon; vertical edges (people, pedestal sides) point radially away from the image centre
camera.floor_scale: uniform over the floor (one metres-per-pixel value for everything at floor level); a point at height h above the floor is magnified by K(h) = H/(H-h) about (960,540), H = camera height above floor
camera.camera_height_relation: H = h_head_point * k/(k-1) = 4.91 * h_head_point (h_head_point = height of the person's head point, ~stature - 0.10 m)
camera.lighting: strong sunlight from lower-left through windows: diagonal window-mullion shadow bands on the floor; every object casts a shadow toward the upper right

objects.name: person
objects.type: human (man, white t-shirt, grey/blue jeans, black shoes, short dark hair; face blurred)
objects.visible_frames: 0-96 (frames 0-19 cut by the top image edge: only legs/torso visible at first; whole body from frame 20; pelvis inside image from frame 7)
objects.role: only moving object; walks straight down the image (+y) along x ~ 812-830, on the left of the central sculpture, between the top-left pedestal and the left bench
objects.reference_point: pelvis_x, pelvis_y (estimated pelvis image position; see notes)

objects.name: central_sculpture
objects.type: white abstract swirl/knot sculpture on a low square blue-edged plinth
objects.note: sits exactly at the image centre (directly below the camera); its cast shadow extends to the upper right up to y ~375

objects.name: bench_left
objects.type: bench with 4 light-blue square cushions in a row, dark frame/backrest rail on its right (inner) side

objects.name: bench_right
objects.type: bench with 4 white/light square cushions, mirror of bench_left, dark rail on its left (inner) side
objects.note: upper end (y 405-437) is a dark base/shadow; boundary less certain than bench_left

objects.name: pedestal_top_left
objects.type: dark grey/black square pedestal with a bronze (copper) twisted sculpture on top
objects.note: partly outside the image; the person starts next to it (to its right) and walks away from it

objects.name: pedestal_bottom
objects.type: grey square pedestal with a small silver/chrome angular sculpture on top

objects.name: floor_tiles
objects.type: light marble floor tiles with thin grout lines
objects.note: faint lines; tiles appear 140 x 131 px (not square in the image)

objects.name: window_light_pattern
objects.type: sunlight/shadow pattern of window mullions on the floor (diagonal and orthogonal bands)

person_summary.direction: straight toward +y (down the image), x nearly constant; no turns
person_summary.gait: 6 front-foot plants, step period ~16.8-17 frames (0.51 s), step length ~67.4 px on the floor (alternating feet x = 836 / 821)
person_summary.apparent_size: head-to-front-foot length shrinks from ~142 px (frame 20) to ~75 px (frame 96) because the person approaches the nadir (perspective lean), NOT because of distance change; mask width ~58-74 px (arms/stride)
person_summary.footprint_spacing: footprint y: 99.4, 168.3, 235.3, 301.5, 368.3, 436.4 (successive plants 67-69 px apart, plants every 16-18 frames)

events.event: video starts; person already walking, entering from the top edge (only legs/lower torso visible)
front foot (right in image, x 836) planted at y 99
whole person inside image (head top at y 7)
video ends; person still walking (pelvis ~ (813, 398), ~2/3 of the way from top edge to the central sculpture's top)
